verdict.rationale: The models page documents `GET /v1/models`. It returns the model names the account can send in the `model` field, with a description and release date for each, and comes with cURL, Python and JavaScript examples plus a response schema. Both SDKs also expose a list-models call (Python AsyncTypeSafeClient and the JavaScript Models interface), so an agent can enumerate the live catalog programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the endpoint, and a published OpenAPI spec (the probe found all candidate paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent enumerate the live model catalog programmatically via a documented models endpoint
